cases.note: The only racing case in this file, and both of its margins have now failed once on dropbox-root. The sleep gives tail time to stat AND download before the file goes; the poll interval gives `rm` plus `mkdir` time to both land before tail looks again. Miss the first and tail's download 409s on a path the stat had just found, so the initial line never prints; miss the second and a poll lands between the two writes, stats ENOENT and reports `has become inaccessible` instead of the EISDIR answer this case is about. Each margin is two round trips against a fake shared with every other target, so the budget is contention, not backend latency: sleep 3 with -s 8 leaves 3s for the first and 5s for the second, against the 1.5s and 1.5s that have each broken.
